title: Ted Turner’s UN philanthropy grows to $4 billion after washerwoman’s $150,000 gift inspires him
summary_full: Inspired by the kindness of a washerwoman, Ted Turner pledged a remarkable $1 billion to the United Nations, paving the way for the creation of the United Nations Foundation. This significant support culminated in an additional $3 billion in funds for essential global causes. Turner's philanthropic spirit has left an indelible mark, motivating countless individuals to engage in positive change and champion worldwide cooperation.
